sense: the state of the air — sun, rain, wind

pins.definition: The state of the atmosphere at a place and time, such as sun, rain, or wind.
The conditions outside at a particular time and place, such as sun, rain, wind, or temperature.
The state of the air and atmosphere outside, such as whether it is hot, cold, sunny, or rainy.

situation: A woman stands on her porch looking out at a sudden shift from bright sun to heavy grey rain and wind.
subject: the atmospheric conditions
brief: A woman stands on a wooden porch holding a teacup, looking out at a landscape split sharply down the middle by the sky: brilliant golden sunlight on one side and a sweeping curtain of slate-grey rain driven by wind on the other.
prompt: A woman stands on a wooden porch holding a teacup, looking out at a landscape split sharply down the middle by the sky: brilliant golden sunlight on one side and a sweeping curtain of slate-grey rain driven by wind on the other. loose watercolour washes over confident ink linework, blooms and granulation in the pigment, warm paper grain, the warmth of a picture book for adults. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
